resources.string: BBZQ module built on the Modern API. Adds SponsorBlock-style skipping, feature enhancements and component cleanup for Bilibili.
A lightweight Xposed module for the Bilibili client that provides segment skipping, feature enhancements and component cleanup.
The launcher icon only shows this introduction. Feature switches are in the in-app settings page.
Remove the splash ad shown at launch to start faster.
Lifts some trial limits and unlocks member qualities.\nNote: do not use this after your trials have run out.
Syncs badges, hints and the trial display layer. Mostly affects what the UI shows.

Always requests QN 127, picks the highest tier the server returns (8K > Dolby Vision > HDR > 4K) with the highest bitrate, and adds a video stats panel with an account watermark to the player controls.
Requires \"Unlock highest bitrate\". Skips HDR and Dolby Vision tiers and picks the best SDR quality of the same level (for non-HDR screens). 8K is not affected.
Lifts mobile-data restrictions so high bitrates and 4K do not fall back to 1080P when not on Wi-Fi.
Sets the quality for half-screen playback (current: %1$s). Choosing a non-default tier blocks low-quality half-screen preloading and locks the quality.
Sets the default quality for full-screen playback (current: %1$s).
On first use, change the quality once manually in the player, then restart to apply.
Adds a download entry to the video description, supports qualities up to 8K and merges them into MP4 automatically.
Likes the video automatically when you open its detail page.
Tries to fix failed quality switching or wrong URLs in live streams on some versions.
Completes reward ads in mini games instantly and grants the reward.
Adds an independent custom thread-count option to the download settings.
Current value: %1$d. Tap to change the number of concurrent downloads in custom mode.
Removes the floating live reservation card on the video page.
Removes survey and rating pop-ups inside live rooms.
Removes the picture mask generated locally by the client in some categories (such as Minecraft and PUBG).
Disable swipe to switch live rooms
Turns off the up/down swipe gesture that switches to another live room, to avoid accidental switches.
Stops long-press from copying directly in comments, posts and descriptions, to avoid accidents.
Requires \"Disable long-press copy\". Covers comments, posts and descriptions with a more flexible text selection window.
Removes tracking parameters from shared links and keeps necessary ones such as page and comment position.
Shows full play counts and statistics on the Me and space pages instead of abbreviated units.
Restores animated GIF thumbnails in comments and removes the member-only badge on images.
Goes straight to the vertical video feed when Bilibili starts.
Open vertical videos as normal videos
Tapping a vertical video opens the regular video page and stops the player from switching back to the vertical feed.
Filters ads and live content in the vertical video feed by tag.
Hides the status bar and gesture navigation bar on the vertical video page.
Does not hide danmaku temporarily when you open comments in vertical videos.
Current value: %1$d%%. Adjusts the opacity of video info, the right-hand actions and the top controls.
Gets and copies the AccessKey of the signed-in account.
AccessKey not found. Make sure you are signed in and have triggered account-related requests.
The entry is now visible. Open the About page for the SponsorBlock switch and category settings.
Skips video segments by the categories you select, based on SponsorBlock data. Off by default.
Handles video segments automatically according to the selected categories.
Likes the video after an automatic skip or after you tap the skip prompt.
Skipping may need to like the video to work properly >﹏<
Select which category tags take part in automatic skipping.
Selected categories only take effect while the main switch is on.
SponsorBlock is on. Adjust the category skip rules as you like.
SponsorBlock is off. Configure the categories first, then turn on the main switch on the previous page.
Go back to change the main switch and read the description.
SponsorBlock is based on hanydd/BilibiliSponsorBlock. Tap to open the project page.
Read the official SponsorBlock API documentation.
Expands short links such as b23.tv and removes tracking parameters, keeping only the necessary ones.
Disables WeChat / QQ mini-program sharing and converts links to AV numbers where possible.
Stops long-press from copying directly anywhere in the app, to avoid accidents.
Requires \"Disable long-press copy\". Intercepts the copy action and opens a text selection window.
Blocks splash ad requests to shorten the startup wait.
Makes the splash background black in dark mode so it does not flash white.
Detects and closes the Teenage Mode reminder automatically.
Blocks update checks inside the app so no version prompt appears.
No keywords set. With card filtering on, recommendations whose title contains a keyword are filtered out.
Separate with new lines, commas or semicolons
Extends the native prefetch distance of the home feed so scrolling to the bottom waits less.
Filters home cards by title keyword and fixed card types.
Checked items are removed. Too many blocked items make the home feed request more often.
Large banners, feed ads and promotion cards that carry ad info.
Image posts, articles and opus cards.
Game center, mini games and cards with game promotion copy.
Course, class and cheese playback cards.
bangumi / pgc episode cards, including anime and film recommendations that route to ep, ss or season.
Vertical video cards that open story/vertical_av by default.
large_cover or inline large video cards.
Hides unwanted entries based on the home tab list that has been read.
No tab data yet. Restart Bilibili and open the home feed first, then come back to BBZQ and choose what to hide.
Checked tabs are removed. Keep at least one tab so the home page can still be created.
Hides the feed RecyclerView in every page under the home container. Handy if you only use Bilibili for search.
Keep or hide specific areas based on the detected home components.
No home component data yet. Open the Bilibili home page and switch sub-tabs, then come back.
Check to keep a component. Uncheck to hide it.
Hides bottom bar entries you do not need. On first use, restart Bilibili and open the home page to load the bar data.
No bottom bar data yet. After turning this on, restart Bilibili and open the home page, then come back to BBZQ and choose what to hide.
Checked items stay in the bar. Unchecked items are hidden.
Hides the game entry at the top of the home page.
Clears the suggested word inside the home search box.
Removes trending lists and suggested searches from the search page and keeps only your search history.
Does not show suggestions or recommendation cards while you type in the search box.
Removes promotion cards and related product cards from the combined search results.

Unlocks region-limited Southeast Asian anime through a resolver server: search results include them, and when the official app refuses playback because of region, the stream comes from the resolver. Your search keywords and the episode you are watching are sent to that server.
No resolver server set. Region unlock will not take effect.
Not set. Leave empty to skip this region.
Send account key to the resolver

Attaches the current account\'s access_key and login cookies when unlocking playback, subtitles and details, which may give higher quality and account-specific content. The credentials go to the server you set, so turn this on only if you trust it.
On, but no resolver server is set yet

Streams of unlocked anime can be slow on your network. Setting a CDN domain for a region replaces the domain of that region\'s main stream address. Leave empty to follow the regular video CDN settings.
Follows the regular video CDN settings
Not set. Try all configured servers together.

Uses the resolver servers you set to watch and search anime that the official app blocks because of region. You can set servers for Hong Kong / Macau, Taiwan, Southeast Asia and Mainland China separately. Fill in only what you need; several servers are tried in turn. Playback and details are requested only when the official app refuses because of region.
Checks whether the resolver server is reachable
Cannot connect to the resolver server
Current: %1$s. This only applies to Southeast Asia gRPC nodes. Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan use the main protocol directly and are not affected.
Adds anime returned by each resolver server to the first page of combined and anime search results. Your search keywords are sent to the configured servers.
When the official app refuses playback because of region, asks the configured resolver servers for the stream in turn. The blocked episode is sent to the server.
When the detail page is region-blocked, strips account info from the original request, re-signs it and sends it to the resolver. No account key is needed.
Lift playback limits on unlocked anime
Clears the official feature restrictions when unlocking playback, so mini window, background play and casting work.
Gets subtitles for the episode from the resolver when an unlocked anime has none. Requires \"Unlock region-blocked playback\".
What is sent to the server
Search keywords, region-blocked episodes and the device identifier used by search requests are sent to each resolver server you set. The account key is not sent by default.
Without an account key the resolver streams as a signed-out user, so quality may be lower and member-only content cannot be unlocked. Downloading unlocked anime is not supported yet.
Hide ads on the video page
Removes the banner, recommendation list, app download, product picks and pause ads below the player on the video page.
Hides video mentions under the description, plus the related cards and pop-ups.
Removes votes, reservations, check-ins, follow prompts, activity cards and overlays inside the player.
Hide auto-opened activity sheets on film pages
Hides promotion sheets such as member offers that open automatically on film, TV and anime pages. Links you tap and purchase entries stay.
When a video declares AI-generated content, jumps to another related video instead; also removes identified AI videos from home and video-page recommendations.
Skipped a video with an AI-generated declaration and switched to a related one
This video declares AI-generated content and was blocked by BBZQ
Removes the \"Yunshiting Xiaodianshi\" promotion sticker at the top left of the player.
Completes video reward ads automatically and claims the reward.
Likes videos you have not liked yet when you open their detail page.
Does not show the end recommendation page after playback in half-screen mode and keeps the replay button. Full-screen playback is unchanged.
Does not show end recommendations in half-screen, landscape or portrait full-screen, so the picture stays on the last frame.
Fix system media card and cover
Allow full screen in split screen
Removes the \"Full screen is not supported\" restriction when you tap the full-screen button in split-screen mode.
No matter what cloud sync or other entries say, audio no longer keeps playing after the screen locks or the app goes to the background.
Fixes the cover turning into a blurred solid colour and the media card disappearing from the system media controls during background playback.
Check for new versions and choose whether to receive pre-releases.
Export or import settings and clear cached data.
Tap to check GitHub Releases for a new version.
New version %1$s found. Tap to download.
Update check failed. Check your network and try again.
Includes pre-release versions when checking for updates.
BBZQ %1$s is available. Open the module settings to download it.
Packs feature switches and manual settings into a ZIP. No data or account content is included.
Restores feature switches and manual settings from a ZIP. Other data is not affected.
Once hidden, open BBZQ from Bilibili\'s \"Settings > Advanced settings\". Turn off \"Force show launcher icon\" in LSPosed first.
Opens the SponsorBlock main switch and the basic description.
Tap to try to get the AccessKey of the signed-in account.
No scan result yet. Start Bilibili first, or tap here to rescan.
Cannot open Bilibili. Open it manually and wait for the rescan to finish.
Type keywords to search switch names. Separate several words with spaces.
Exported %1$d feature switches and %2$d manual settings.
Imported %1$d feature switches and %2$d manual settings, skipped %3$d other items.
This overwrites your current feature switches and manual settings. Other data is not changed. Continue?

AccessKey not found yet. Please make sure that:
1. You are signed in to Bilibili
2. You have used Bilibili normally (watch a few videos)
3. If it still fails, clear the app cache and retry, or file an issue
Removes the comments tab from the video page.
Tapping comment text no longer opens the reply box automatically.
Filters up/down vote and side-picking widgets in comments.
Removes the follow button to the right of each comment.
Remove keyword search links in comments
Turns off tap-to-search keywords inside comment text.
Does not show the quick comment prompt when there are no comments.
Blocks experience feedback and survey pop-ups in comments.
Hides activity and promotion banners at the top of comments.
Hides trending discussion cards mixed into comments.
Hides a comment and its replies when the text contains a keyword you set.
One keyword per line, or separate with commas or semicolons
No keywords set. When on, comments whose text contains a keyword are hidden.
Hides comments from users below the set level, together with their replies.
Only comments from users at level %1$d or higher are shown.
Removes the member card from the Me page.
Keeps its space when the member entry is hidden so the page does not jump.
After opening the Me page once, choose which service entries to hide.
No component data yet. Open Bilibili\'s Me page once, then come back.
Checked components stay. Unchecked ones are hidden.
Opens the video tab first on the dynamics page.
Hides the city entry on the dynamics page.
Hides the campus entry on the dynamics page.
Extends the video page under the status bar and makes it transparent. Some systems may still show status bar icons.
Hides the portrait switch button in the player controls.
3x speed is a server-side A/B test. Turning this on forces the test group: the speed menu gets a 3.0x tier and the 50 fps limit is removed.
Landscape only: slide down while long-pressing to lock the speed; long-press and slide down again to release it.
Requires \"Unlock 3x playback speed\". Replaces the long-press fast-forward speed with the value below (such as 2.5x or 4x).
Used in order: backup URL → base URL (not recommended)
Used in order: backup URL → %1$s → base URL (not recommended)
Used in order: backup URL → base URL (not recommended)
Used in order: backup URL → %1$s → base URL (not recommended)
Up to 5 nodes. If a connection fails, the next one is used automatically.
You can choose up to 5 CDN nodes
Uses the backup URL directly. Can fix videos with no sound.
Enter a domain name (port optional). Do not include a path or query.
Please enter a valid CDN host.
Tests the latency and download speed of each UPOS server to find the best node.
All CDNs start together. Cool-down is ignored.
Tests in order with a cool-down in between.
Adds a theme with your own main color to Bilibili\'s theme list. Re-open the theme page after changing it.
Enter a 6-digit hex color, for example FB7299.
Please enter a valid 6-digit hex color.
Uses the imported theme config. Restart Bilibili after saving to apply it.
The config must be a valid theme JSON that contains package_url.
Skin config imported. It will apply after Bilibili restarts.
Hides cards in the feed below the video by type and title keyword.
No keywords set. Tap to add keywords and filter recommendations by video title.
Enter the recommendation title keywords to block. Separate several keywords with new lines or commas.
Checked types are blocked. Types found on the video page appear here after you refresh it.
No card types yet. Turn the switch on and open a video page once; the card types found will appear here.
Force-stops and restarts Bilibili with Root or Shizuku permission so every change takes effect immediately.
Bilibili will be force-stopped and restarted with Root or Shizuku permission so every module setting takes effect immediately. Continue?
Could not get Root permission. Make sure the device is rooted and BBZQ is allowed in your root manager (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch). Without Root, Shizuku can also force-stop apps.

Blocks the resource pool list from being delivered and stops component modules from downloading. Matches \"App base components\" in the storage settings.\nNote: this only blocks later downloads. Space already used must be cleared manually in Bilibili\'s storage settings.
Blocks every resource pool without checking them one by one. Useful when no candidate pools have been found yet.
When on, check the resource pools to block below. Checked pools take effect immediately.
No resource pool data yet. Bilibili delivers the list in batches on demand, so it builds up after some normal use.
BBZQ only works with LSPosed, NPatch or Vector. The current environment is not supported.
In LSPosed, BBZQ needs Root permission. Please allow it in your root manager (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch).
Open BBZQ from Bilibili\'s \"Settings > Advanced settings\"
